{{Quote|The ''Conqueror'' will destroy the Rebel Alliance, planet by planet!|Victor Strang|<ref name="Light" />}}
The '''''Conqueror''''' was an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] armed with a [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] that was in operation during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Conceived as a replacement for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]-destroying [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], lost at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the ''Conqueror'' was intended to slow the momentum of the rapidly growing [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The superlaser component of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] was constructed at an Imperial [[Imperial Weapon Research Facility|research facility]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] under the supervision of the Imperial [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commandos]]. It was projected that the superlaser on the ''Conqueror'', when properly installed, would give the Star Destroyer the ability to break apart a small moon, or crack a continent in half.<ref name="Imperial Handbook" /> By [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the weapon was equipped on the ''Conqueror'', and the Star Destroyer was located in the [[Mustafar system/Legends|Mustafar system]], where it was commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Victor Strang]]. There, the Star Destroyer's superlaser was successfully tested on a [[Unidentified Mustafar system planetoid|small planetoid]].

Shortly thereafter, the Alliance's [[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron]] came across information on the ''Conqueror'' during several [[Mission to Naboo (Renegade Squadron)|raids]] on Imperial facilities located on Naboo, and they set out to destroy the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]]. After hijacking a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] that was bound for the ''Conqueror'', the Renegades were able to [[Mission to Mustafar (Renegade Squadron)|infiltrate]] the Star Destroyer and plant timed [[Thermal detonator/Legends|explosives]] on the ship's [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]], which would cause the vessel to explode once detonated. Strang and the Imperial forces on the ship were unable to stop the Rebels, and after a confrontation with [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] enforcer, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], who had recently arrived on the ship, the Renegades were able to escape the ''Conqueror'' shortly before it was destroyed.

==Description==
{{Quote|This Star Destroyer is fitted with a massive superlaser, much like the one on the Death Star.|Victor Strang|<ref name="Light" />}}
The ''Conqueror'' was a 1,600-[[Meter/Legends|meter]]-long<ref name="Light" /> [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]].<ref name="Imperial Handbook" /> The [[Starship/Legends|starship]] had a spacious [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay that was large enough to hold several [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttles]], a [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], and an [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom]] [[X4 Gunship/Legends|X4 Gunship]]. In the aft section of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] was the ship's [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]]. The vessel had a number of security measures installed in case of an emergency, including [[Blast door/Legends|blast doors]], an [[Alarm system/Legends|alarm system]], and red emergency lights placed along ship's corridors.<ref name="Light" />

The ''Conqueror''{{'s}} most distinguishing feature was a [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]], similar to the [[Concave Dish Composite Beam Superlaser|one]] used on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]], which was built into the vessel's bow<ref name="Light" /> and took up much of the surrounding area, bisecting the forward section of the Star Destroyer.<ref name="Conqueror">{{SWGTCG|set=Threat of the Conqueror|cardname=Conqueror}}, based on visual observation of the ''Conqueror''{{'s}} image</ref> The superlaser consisted of several [[Tributary beam|beam generators]]<ref name="Light" /> arrayed around a concave circular dish<ref name="Conqueror" /> located on the prow of the ship. When the weapon was fired, beams emanated from the generators and converged into a single green [[Laser/Legends|laser]] capable of destroying a small [[Moon/Legends|moon]],<ref name="Light" /> and at the very least crack a continent in half and melt cities,<ref name="Imperial Handbook" /> although it was purported to have the ability to demolish entire [[Planet/Legends|planets]] as well.<ref name="Description">The description of the overall ''[[Threat of the Conqueror]]'' campaign located within the game states the following: "The Conqueror, an Imperial Star Destroyer, is armed with a planet-destroying weapon like the one on the Death Star battlestation."</ref><ref name="TOS">{{SWArchive|url=games/videogames/news20100218galaxies/index.html|text=Star Wars Galaxies TCG: Threat of the Conqueror Expansion}}</ref><ref name="Strang">{{SWGTCG|set=Threat of the Conqueror|cardname=Victor Strang}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|This is my ship. You're not taking her from me.|Victor Strang, to Renegade Squadron|<ref name="Light" />}}
The ''Conqueror'' was conceived as a replacement for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] first [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]],<ref name="Sony">{{SonyCite|url=tradingcardgame/cardsets.vm?set=totc|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies™ Trading Card Game: Threat of the Conqueror}}</ref> a [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] capable of annihilating planets that was destroyed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> However, the concept itself and to a lesser extent the retrofitting of the ''Conqueror'' itself was experimented on as early as 0 BBY, and was included in the official field guide for officers of the Imperial Military, the ''Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide''. During this time, the project ran into issues with miniaturization and power output, as well as plans to create more Star Destroyers equipped with superlasers.<ref name="Imperial Handbook" /> With the Rebels quickly gaining momentum in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was intent on swiftly halting the uprising through a crippling counterattack intended to demoralize the Alliance. The project to develop the ''Conqueror''{{'s}} superlaser was spearheaded by the Empire's elite [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commandos]],<ref name="Sony" /> led by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Victor Strang]],<ref name="Light" /> who intended to use the weapon to destroy worlds affiliated with the Alliance.<ref name="Strang" />

The superlaser was developed at an Imperial [[Imperial Weapon Research Facility|research facility]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], which was guarded by the Imperial-allied [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]] [[Namman Cha]]. Eventually, the weapon was fitted onto the ''Conqueror'', and by [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] the Star Destroyer had been put under Strang's command and stationed in the [[Mustafar system/Legends|Mustafar system]]. [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] became involved with the project, and [[Director of Imperial Intelligence|Intelligence Director]] [[Ysanne Isard]] herself began overseeing the operation, working in conjunction with the [[Blackguard (Mustafar)/Legends|Blackguard]],<ref name="Light" /> a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] cult based on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].<ref name="JATM">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''</ref> At some point, the ''Conqueror'' performed a successful test of its superlaser, obliterating a small, [[Unidentified Mustafar system planetoid|uninhabited planetoid]] in the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. This test was documented and sent to the research facility on Naboo.<ref name="Light" />

[[File:Vader-TotC.jpg|thumb|left|Darth Vader confronts Renegade Squadron aboard the ''Conqueror''.]]
Soon after, the Alliance learned of the ''Conqueror''{{'s}} existence after a [[Mission to Naboo (Renegade Squadron)|raid]] on an Imperial [[Naboo weapons depot|weapons depot]] on Naboo, which was carried out by the Alliance's elite [[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron]], led by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Col Serra]]. The team turned up [[Datafile/Legends|datafiles]] containing information on the Star Destroyer. The Renegades discovered the research facility where the superlaser was developed and infiltrated it, defeating Namman Cha and gaining access to the [[Computer/Legends|computer]] consoles located there. Once they came across the recording of the ''Conqueror''{{'s}} weapons test and discovered the ship's location, they [[Mission to Mustafar (Renegade Squadron)|headed]] to Mustafar and hijacked one of the Imperial supply [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] that flew between the ''Conqueror'' and the surface of the planet each day. The team intended to use it to board the superweapon and destroy the vessel.<ref name="Light" />

The Renegades were able to provide the correct identification codes to dock with the ''Conqueror'', and upon arrival in the ship's hangar, they opened fire on the surrounding [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. This alerted the Imperials to their presence and set off the ship's alarm system. They made their way to the ''Conqueror''{{'s}} critical reactor core, which the Renegades hoped to destroy using [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]], thereby causing the ship to explode. On the way there, the team was encountered by Strang and his storm [[Commando/Legends|commandos]]. Serra and the Renegades defeated them and eventually reached the reactor core, placing timed detonation charges around it. Simultaneously, the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] enforcer, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], arrived aboard the vessel to see to the superweapon's safe delivery to the Emperor. After ten [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] of fighting through the ship's corridors, the Renegades reached the hangar, intending to leave on the very shuttle they arrived in. There, they were confronted by Vader and a group of storm commandos. Serra and the Renegades were able to gain the upper hand in the subsequent firefight and escaped the ''Conqueror'' as the detonators exploded and destroyed the ship. Despite their success, two Imperial vessels, including Vader's, were able to escape the destruction as well.<ref name="Light" />

[[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]] later confirmed its destruction in the ''Imperial Handbook'' after a copy was supplied to the Rebel Alliance, in the aftermath of the Battle of Endor.<ref name="Imperial Handbook" />

==Commanders and crew==
{{Quote|Admiral Strang? Victor Strang? He's the captain? He used to lead a team of Storm Commandos. Stay sharp, men. This will be no ordinary boarding action.|Col Serra|<ref name="Light" />}}
[[File:VictorStrang-TotC.png|thumb|200px|right|Admiral Victor Strang, the ''Conqueror''{{'s}} commander]]
At the [[Time/Legends|time]] that it was stationed in the Mustafar system, the ''Conqueror'' was [[Captain/Legends|captained]] by Admiral Victor Strang, a former storm commando leader. Strang kept a personal guard of storm commandos with him on the Star Destroyer, which he brought along when he encountered Renegade Squadron aboard the vessel. He was protective of his ship, disliking the idea of it being stolen or destroyed, and personally confronted the Renegades when they attempted to achieve the latter. Just before the ''Conqueror''{{'s}} destruction, an Incom X4 [[Gunship/Legends|Gunship]], which one of the Renegades thought may have been carrying Strang, escaped the doomed Star Destroyer.<ref name="Light" />

Along with Strang's storm commandos, the ''Conqueror'' carried a number of stormtroopers and [[Imperial Navy Trooper/Legends|Imperial Navy troopers]]. Stormtroopers were present in the ship's hangar when Renegade Squadron first arrived aboard the vessel, and [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] attempted to halt the advance of Serra and his Renegades when they were making their way to the ship's reactor core. Stormtroopers and Navy troopers were also encountered by the Renegades at several critical junctions across the ship on the way back to the ''Conqueror''{{'s}} hangar. Additionally, several groups of workers were spread throughout the large hangar bay at the time.<ref name="Light" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Conqueror'' was created for the [[2010]] ''[[Threat of the Conqueror]]'' expansion set of the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]'' developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment. The Star Destroyer was featured in the Light Side scenario campaign for the set, in which the player character joins Renegade Squadron in uncovering information on the ship and destroying it.<ref name="Light" /> It also received its own card in the set, an item card usable only by Imperial players,<ref name="Conqueror" /> and was referenced on several others.<ref name="Strang" /><ref name="Vader">{{SWGTCG|set=Threat of the Conqueror|cardname=Darth Vader}} {{C|Avatar}}</ref><ref name="NammanCha">{{SWGTCG|set=Threat of the Conqueror|cardname=Namman Cha}}</ref><ref name="Isard">{{SWGTCG|set=Threat of the Conqueror|cardname=Ysanne Isard}}</ref> The ''Conqueror'' was illustrated by artist [[Derek Herring]].<ref name="Collection">''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]'' in-game collection manager</ref>

===Discrepancies===
Promotional material on Sony's website concerning ''Threat of the Conqueror'' indicates that the Rebel Alliance assigns Renegade Squadron to specifically target and destroy the ''Conqueror''.<ref name="Sony" /> However, the Light Side scenario campaign depicts the Renegades attacking an Imperial weapons depot and coincidentally coming across information on the ''Conqueror'' themselves, which they then set out to destroy. A description of the campaign within the game also indicates the involvement of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in the mission to search for the ''Conqueror'', although they are never mentioned in the campaign.<ref name="Light" /> Additionally, promotional material indicates the ''Conqueror''{{'s}} involvement in the Dark Side scenario campaign as a weapon used by the storm commandos,<ref name="Sony" /> but the ''Conqueror'' neither appears nor is mentioned in the narrative of that campaign.<ref name="Dark">{{SWGTCG|set=Threat of the Conqueror|scenario=Dark Side scenario campaign}}</ref>

The destructive capability of the ''Conqueror''{{'s}} superlaser is only ever witnessed during the test on the rogue planetoid in the Light Side scenario campaign.<ref name="Light" /> However, promotional material on [[StarWars.com]] indicates that the Star Destroyer's superlaser has the ability to destroy whole planets,<ref name="TOS" /> as does the in-game synopsis for the overall campaign<ref name="Light" /> and the quote provided for Victor Strang on his card.<ref name="Strang" />

The only images of the ''Conqueror'', featured on the Star Destroyer's card and on Sony's website, depict the ship hovering over a [[City/Legends|city]] with its superlaser being fired while Strang and his [[Troop/Legends|troops]] engage in combat on the ground.<ref name="Conqueror" /><ref name="Sony" /> However, this scene is completely absent from the Light Side scenario campaign. In the campaign, the ''Conqueror'' is only ever seen stationed in the Mustafar system, where its weapon is tested, and is destroyed by Renegade Squadron shortly afterward.<ref name="Light" />
